name: 无底的流沙
desc: 对方的结束阶段时只有1次，场上表侧表示存在的攻击力最高的怪兽破坏。自己的准备阶段时自己手卡是4张以下的场合，这张卡破坏。
faq:
If there are multiple monsters tied for the highest ATK, they are all destroyed.
If "Bottomless Shifting Sand" is active and "Tyrant Dragon" is the monster with the highest ATK, "Tyrant Dragon" is destroyed because "Bottomless Shifting Sand" does not target a monster.
ruling: If more than one monster ties for highest ATK value in the End Phase while “Bottomless Shifting Sand” is active, all of those monsters will be destroyed by the effect of “Bottomless Shifting Sand.”
